done_when: the root cause of each intermittent failure is found and fixed in the test or the code, never by skipping or retrying, and each test passes 30 times in a row under pytest-xdist on this machine

findings.body: The added scenarios repeat existing command-level coverage: tests/test_codex_record.py:209–227 already checks SIGINT cleanup of the lock, driver and server, and tests/test_codex_reader.py:94–98 already checks crashed-read cleanup through `forge doctor`. Both already exercise the modified helpers. The new file adds repeated repository setup and process launches without independently guarding either fix. Move the additional pre-cleanup liveness assertion into the existing cold-read test and remove the duplicate scenarios, consistent with the requested complexity and test-audit constraints.
findings.title: Simpler: duplicate process tests → extend the existing tests

why: Two process tests fail intermittently on CI and block unrelated pull requests: tests/test_codex_record.py::test_5_one_worker_per_item and tests/test_codex_reader.py::test_10_the_cold_read_runs_on_the_other_family
